card.name: Inside long drug and medical names
card.fires_on: Partway through long drug or medical terms, on a middle piece such as 'oth' in hydrochlorothiazide, 'ip' in glipizide, 'pro' in valproate or 'chlor' in hydrochloride. Seen mostly in drug-label text.
